name: google-test-adapter
description: Diagnose and configure Google Test Adapter, which shows and runs Google Test tests and Google Benchmark benchmarks in Visual Studio's Test Explorer.

interface.shortDescription: Google Test and Google Benchmark in Visual Studio's Test Explorer
interface.longDescription: Finds out why Google Test tests or Google Benchmark benchmarks of a Visual Studio solution don't show up or run as expected in Test Explorer, and configures Google Test Adapter (options, solution and project settings), using its automation object in the running Visual Studio.
defaultPrompt: Why don't my Google Test tests show up in Test Explorer?
Run the benchmarks of my solution with real measurements instead of dry runs.
